gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma; IDH Wild-type and STAT3-positive Glioblastoma
New histologically confirmed diagnosis of glioblastoma (WHO 2021)

candidate_evidence.quote: Silibinin will be continued until disease progression or up to 24 months.

candidate_flag.reason: Silibinin is registered as a dietary supplement (Sillbrain sachets); no marketing authorisation as a medicine is stated, so treated as an excluded supplement. If judged pharmacological, the trial would have a candidate.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Silibinin in Association With Concomitant Chemoradiotherapy and Maintenance Temozolomide in STAT3 Positive IDH Wild-type, Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma Patients

role_evidence.quote: Each 3.7 g sachet of Sillbrain contains 500 mg silibinin.

agents.drug_class_hint: flavonolignan dietary supplement, proposed STAT3 inhibitor

flag.reason: Registered as dietary supplement; candidate status depends on whether it counts as a supplement without marketing authorisation.

role_evidence.quote: Concomitant radiotherapy (60 gy in 30 fractions) + temozolomide 75mg/mq + placebo 2 sachets/day dissolved in water throughout concomitant treatment

source_quote.quote: Immunohistochemical positivity of activated STAT3 (pSTAT3) expression on the tumor tissue sample.

flag.reason: pSTAT3 is mechanistically linked to silibinin (STAT3 inhibitor), but silibinin is coded as an excluded supplement, not a candidate; would be candidate-matched if silibinin were a candidate.

coder_notes: Placebo is not listed as an agent. Silibinin is registered as Dietary Supplement and the record gives no marketing authorisation; coded excluded_intervention_type, which makes the trial fail S6. Adjudicator should confirm. IDH-wildtype is stated in the title and conditions rather than a dedicated eligibility bullet.
